paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: Proportion of incorrectly answered samples where RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the proportion (as a percentage) of incorrectly answered samples for which the popularity ratio of the generated answer (RPop_Ge) is lower than that of the ground truth (RPop_GT), across three distinct domains — Movies, Songs, and Basketball — and for three large language models: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). The vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, spans from 50% to 90% with major gridlines at 10% intervals, indicating the percentage of such incorrect samples. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by domain, with each domain represented by three adjacent bars corresponding to the three models. In the “Movies” category, Llama3 and Qwen2 both show values near 90%, while ChatGPT is lower at approximately 73%. In “Songs”, Llama3 is around 84%, Qwen2 remains near 90%, and ChatGPT drops to about 62%. For “Basketball”, Llama3 is at roughly 67%, Qwen2 falls to approximately 58%, and ChatGPT is slightly higher at about 61%. The bars are grouped by domain and colored consistently according to the legend, with no additional visual emphasis such as shading or outlines applied to any specific bar. The chart does not indicate whether the categories are ordered by any specific criterion, and no trend across domains is explicitly suggested by the layout.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the proportion (as a percentage) of incorrectly answered samples in which the popularity ratio of the generated answer (RPop_Ge) is less than that of the ground truth (RPop_GT), across three distinct domains — Movies, Songs, and Basketball — for three large language models: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). The vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, ranges from 50% to 90% with tick marks at 5% intervals, while the horizontal axis categorizes the domains. In the Movies category, Llama3 and Qwen2 both show high ratios near 90%, while ChatGPT is lower at approximately 73%. In Songs, Llama3 and Qwen2 again exhibit high values (~84% and ~90%, respectively), with ChatGPT at ~62%. In Basketball, Llama3 is at ~67%, Qwen2 drops significantly to ~58%, and ChatGPT is at ~61%. The chart visually suggests that Qwen2 and Llama3 tend to generate answers with lower popularity than ground truth more frequently than ChatGPT, particularly in Movies and Songs, while in Basketball, all models show lower ratios, with Qwen2 performing notably worse. The bars are grouped by domain, with each model’s bar clearly color-coded and labeled in the legend.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht für drei Large Language Models — Llama3 (blau), Qwen2 (rot) und ChatGPT (gelb) — den Anteil der falsch beantworteten Proben, bei denen der Popularity-Ratio der generierten Antwort (RPop_Ge) niedriger ist als der Popularity-Ratio der Ground-Truth-Antwort (RPop_GT), gruppiert nach drei Kategorien: Movies, Songs und Basketball. Die horizontale Achse zeigt diese drei Kategorien in der Reihenfolge Movies, Songs, Basketball, während die vertikale Achse den „Ratio (%)“ von 50 bis 90 in Schritten von 10 anzeigt. In der Kategorie „Movies“ liegen die Werte für Llama3 und Qwen2 nahe bei 90 %, während ChatGPT mit etwa 73 % deutlich niedriger liegt. In „Songs“ erreichen Llama3 und Qwen2 ebenfalls Werte von etwa 84 % bzw. 90 %, ChatGPT liegt hier bei etwa 62 %. In „Basketball“ fällt Qwen2 mit etwa 58 % am niedrigsten aus, während Llama3 bei etwa 67 % und ChatGPT bei etwa 61 % liegt. Die Balken sind in jeder Kategorie gruppiert, wobei die Farben entsprechend der Legende zugeordnet sind, und es gibt keine visuelle Hervorhebung oder Sortierung der Balken außer der Kategorienreihenfolge auf der x-Achse.
